route.purpose: Choose the game-specific route and evaluation method before doing game work.

design.purpose: Read the game's skill and produce a high-level level design and constraints.

evaluate.purpose: Use the game's solver or playtest guidance to check a design or existing level.

implement.purpose: Create or revise the level using the declared game interface.

verify.purpose: Verify only what the declared interface can measure and report gaps honestly.

match3_adapter.verification: Schema and rules validation, then seeded bot simulation. Do not claim completion until the adapter is connected and returns results.

platformer_adapter.verification: Use adapter validation, shortest-route solve, and seeded bot simulation. Browser loading and play events remain pending a connected game client.

geometry_dash_editor_mobilerun.verification: Mobilerun may confirm editor navigation, local save, and visual loading. It cannot prove frame-exact completion or difficulty.

watersort_adapter.verification: Schema and rules validation, exact breadth-first solve (solvable within move_limit, minimum pours), then seeded bot simulation (human, greedy, random). The adapter is in games/watersort/adapter but not registered in platform/mcp/src/adapters.ts yet; do not claim results until the platform returns them.

racer_adapter.verification: Schema and rules validation, exact fastest-finish solve (solvable within time_limit, minimum ticks), then seeded bot simulation (human, greedy, random). The adapter is in games/racer/adapter but not registered in platform/mcp/src/adapters.ts yet; do not claim results until the platform returns them.

lotescape_adapter.verification: Validate the parking lot and use the exact solver for minimum car-step moves. The browser client works locally; platform registry and hosting are pending.
